positions.description:
Working on Radar dashboards which provides end users with a quick, summarized view of key, aggregated data. In general, data is presented visually, using graphs, charts and summarized reports. Dashboards can be customized by work group or stakeholder. Although Radar dashboards are not technically a report type, it is a method for turning data into actionable intelligence.

Also, Certified in Epic Healthy Planet which provides healthcare systems with the tools to coordinate care delivery, monitor quality and cost, reduce financial risk and engage patients through a centralized data warehouse and complete view of all of their patients.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
[Technology Used: JAVA, GIT, REST, Spring Framework, Android SDK, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, DynamoDb, Selenium, Weblab, Alexa SDK, Unity SDK]
•	Architected and led addition of Gift Card as Payment Instrument in Amazon Pay workflow from end-to-end. 
•	Developed Dynamic UI pages for Amazon Pay app in Clover Kiosk using Android Fragment making page load time efficient. 
•	Added feature to support multiple store in backend using AWS SQS, AWS SNS and DynamoDb. 
•	Designed and implemented external facing RESTful API’s in JAVA using Spring Framework. 
•	Created end to end integration test for customer facing “Your Account” website using carbon framework. 
•	Enabled Your Account website for rebranding Pay with Amazon using Weblab. 
•	Developed Alexa Skill for playing traditional Guess Who Game which won Alexa Hackathon held in Bangalore on October 2016.
•	Prototyped VirtualReality integration on Amazon Retail app with google cardboard in Amazon Millennials Hackathon 2017 using Unity.
•	Worked in Scrum based Agile software development model. Performed code reviews and worked with Quality Assurance and UI designers to deliver high quality product .

projects.title: Implemented Distributed in-memory Graph solution for FSO Problem
projects.description: Designed and implemented Graph in distributed manner using Hadoop MapReduce. Vertices represent a single file and edge connecting two files contains top 10% frequency word. Graph is stored in-memory for faster turnaround time. Supports query operation like relation, transitive closure and minimum weighted clique.

projects.title: Parallel DenStream Algorithm
projects.description:
Parallel implementation of well known stream mining algorithm (DenStream) for class imbalance problem.
Developed a distributed architecture for detecting spam in streaming environment. Class Imbalance problems motivated us to perform clustering for classification problem. Proposed streaming algorithm for classification Den-KMeans created overhead in IO Cost when deployed on distributed map reduce architecture. Speed up obtained from sequential version to distribute is not much noticeable because of high dependency of modules in Den-Stream algorithm. Proposed algorithm performs better than compared to serial execution on streaming data with higher accuracy rate.
